a11y.statement.title: Accessibility
a11y.statement.intro: We want every part of this product to be usable by everyone. This statement describes what we have tested, how we tested it, and what is still missing — it describes our method rather than claiming a conformance level.
a11y.statement.standard: Target standard: WCAG 2.2, Level AA. We test against that standard; we do not claim conformance with it, because the independent audit that could verify a claim has not happened (see known gaps).
a11y.statement.methodAutomated: Automated sweeps: an axe-core scan of every route, in both locales (English and Japanese) and both light and dark themes. Serious and critical findings block release.
a11y.statement.methodKeyboard: Keyboard: scripted keyboard-only passes complete the critical journeys — checkout, connecting a domain, publishing a campaign, and changing a plan — without a mouse, including focus order and return-on-close for dialogs.
a11y.statement.methodLayout: Layout: 400% zoom (320 px reflow) checks in both locales, reduced-motion and forced-colours emulation passes, and a contrast gate over our published themes. Evidence is recorded with dates in our manual-pass log.
a11y.statement.gapAudit: No independent WCAG audit has been carried out. Automated tools catch only part of WCAG, so this statement cannot honestly claim conformance; an external audit is the largest outstanding gap.
a11y.statement.gapScreenReaders: Screen readers: NVDA and JAWS have not been tested, and a VoiceOver pass on macOS had not been completed when this statement was last updated. Screen-reader behaviour beyond automated structure checks is therefore unverified.
a11y.statement.feedback: If you hit a barrier using this product, contact support and include the page, what you were trying to do, and the assistive technology you use. We triage accessibility reports as product defects.
